Name: Qwen
What It Does: Official repository for the original Qwen chat and pretrained large language model family.
Notes: Older generation repo; GitHub notes it is no longer actively maintained.

Name: Qwen3
What It Does: Official repository for the Qwen3 large language model series.
Notes: Core open-weight Qwen3 family.

Name: Qwen3.6
What It Does: Official repository for the Qwen3.6 language model series.
Notes: Newer flagship open family in the org.

Name: QwQ
What It Does: Official repository for Qwen's reasoning-focused model series.
Notes: Reasoning-first line; strong overlap with tool-use demos.

Name: Qwen2.5-Math
What It Does: Math-specialized Qwen2-series models supporting chain-of-thought and tool-integrated reasoning.
Notes: Local demo explicitly references Qwen-Agent for TIR.

Name: qwen3-max
What It Does: Alibaba Cloud's top-tier proprietary Qwen API model for complex reasoning and large-context work.
Notes: Confirmed in Alibaba Cloud Model Studio docs.

Name: qwen3.5-plus
What It Does: Balanced hosted Qwen model with very large context and multimodal input support.
Notes: Docs state it supports text image and video inputs.

Name: qwen3.5-flash
What It Does: Fast low-cost hosted Qwen model for simple or high-throughput tasks.
Notes: Hosted-only model family in Model Studio.

Name: Qwen3-VL
What It Does: Official multimodal Qwen3 vision-language model family for image and video understanding and visual agent tasks.
Notes: Repo text explicitly mentions visual agent and visual coding boosts.

Name: Qwen3-Omni
What It Does: Official end-to-end omni-modal Qwen model handling text audio image and video with real-time speech output.
Notes: Bridges multimodal understanding with speech generation.

Name: Qwen2.5-Omni
What It Does: End-to-end multimodal model for text image audio and video with streaming text and speech responses.
Notes: Previous omni generation; docs mention deployment with vLLM and MNN.

Name: Qwen-Image
What It Does: Official image generation foundation model with strong text rendering and image editing.
Notes: Core Qwen image-generation repo.

Name: Qwen-Image-Layered
What It Does: Layered decomposition system for editable image generation and manipulation.
Notes: Specialized image-editing companion to Qwen-Image.

Name: Qwen3-VL-Embedding
What It Does: Official multimodal embedding model family for text image and video representation.
Notes: Repo stars and metadata from org page.

Name: Qwen3-TTS
What It Does: Official open-source text-to-speech models supporting expressive streaming generation voice design and cloning.
Notes: Strong fit for voice agents and multimodal chat.

Name: Qwen3-ASR
What It Does: Official open-source speech recognition models for multilingual speech music and song transcription.
Notes: Complements TTS and omni lines.

Name: Qwen3-ASR-Toolkit
What It Does: Official Python toolkit for high-throughput Qwen3-ASR API usage and long-audio transcription.
Notes: Useful if you want hosted ASR without self-hosting models.

Name: Qwen2-Audio
What It Does: Official repository for Qwen's large audio language model family.
Notes: Audio-language predecessor to newer multimodal audio work.

Name: qwen3-livetranslate-flash-realtime
What It Does: Real-time audio and video translation model using both speech and visual context.
Notes: Official Alibaba Cloud Model Studio doc states 18 languages plus dialect support.

Name: CosyVoice
What It Does: Multilingual voice generation model with inference training and deployment support.
Notes: Hugging Face and PyPI pages show multiple released checkpoints and deployment examples.

Name: SenseVoice
What It Does: Multilingual voice understanding model for speech recognition and audio understanding tasks.
Notes: License displayed as Other on GitHub org page.

Name: Fun-ASR
What It Does: End-to-end speech recognition large model and toolkit from Tongyi Lab.
Notes: GitHub repo and PyPI both emphasize CPU-capable deployment paths.

Name: Fun-Audio-Chat
What It Does: Large audio language model for natural low-latency voice interactions.
Notes: HF card gives detailed model description and Apache-2.0 license.

Name: ThinkSound
What It Does: Unified framework for generating audio from any modality using chain-of-thought guidance.
Notes: Strong multimodal audio-generation Lego piece.

Name: Qwen-Agent
What It Does: Agent framework and example applications built on Qwen with function calling MCP code interpreter and RAG.
Notes: Directly used by SpaceBot tool-service code.

Name: qwen-code
What It Does: Open-source AI coding agent that runs in the terminal.
Notes: Also distributed on npm as @qwen-code/qwen-code.

Name: AgentScope
What It Does: Production-ready framework for building and running transparent multi-agent applications.
Notes: Confirmed by docs and PyPI package.

Name: AgentScope Runtime
What It Does: Production runtime for agent apps with sandboxing deployment and agent-as-a-service APIs.
Notes: Runtime package exists on PyPI as agentscope-runtime.

Name: AgentScope Studio
What It Does: Local web app for project management tracing visualization and Friday copilot around AgentScope apps.
Notes: Docs page states npm install @agentscope/studio and local deployment.

Name: ReMe
What It Does: Memory management kit for agents focused on long-term memory retrieval and refinement.
Notes: SpaceBot docs confirm a live reme-mcp service.

Name: HiClaw
What It Does: Collaborative multi-agent operating system built around transparent human-in-the-loop coordination via Matrix rooms.
Notes: Strong orchestration Lego piece for multi-agent teamwork.

Name: QwenPaw
What It Does: Personal AI assistant that supports multiple chat apps and extensible skills.
Notes: High-visibility product-style agent app.

Name: text-embedding-v4
What It Does: Hosted multilingual embedding model family in Model Studio.
Notes: Docs say it is part of the Qwen3-Embedding series.

Name: qwen3-embedding
What It Does: Open embedding model family for multilingual retrieval code retrieval and clustering tasks.
Notes: Stars and timestamp from org repo page; open repo has no license shown in snippet, so marked unknown.

Name: qwen3-rerank
What It Does: Hosted reranking model for semantic retrieval and relevance ordering.
Notes: Official Model Studio ranking section lists qwen3-rerank.

Name: DeepResearch
What It Does: Open-source deep research agent from Tongyi Lab for long-horizon information-seeking tasks.
Notes: Also appears on OpenRouter as Tongyi DeepResearch 30B A3B.

Name: ZeroSearch
What It Does: Research project for incentivizing search capability in LLMs without external search during training.
Notes: Strong research Lego piece for agentic search training loops.

Name: CHRONOS
What It Does: Iterative self-questioning system for news retrieval and timeline summarization.
Notes: Useful subcomponent for research and knowledge workflows.

Name: MaskSearch
What It Does: Pre-training framework to improve agentic search capability.
Notes: Repo description in org listing directly frames it as search-pretraining.

Name: E2Rank
What It Does: Listwise reranker showing that text embeddings can function as effective rerankers.
Notes: Hidden-gem candidate because of low stars and practical relevance.

Name: Qwen3-Coder
What It Does: Code-specialized model family in the Qwen3 series.
Notes: Primary open-weight coding model family behind multiple Qwen coding surfaces.

Name: ms-swift
What It Does: Training and fine-tuning toolkit covering hundreds of LLMs and multimodal models including Qwen families.
Notes: One of the most strategically important ModelScope repos.

Name: OpenJudge
What It Does: Unified framework for holistic evaluation and quality rewards.
Notes: Evaluation/reward component inside AgentScope ecosystem.

Name: PolyMath
What It Does: Evaluation code for multilingual mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
Notes: Low-star but strategically useful benchmark asset.

Name: ProcessBench
What It Does: Benchmark for identifying process errors in mathematical reasoning.
Notes: Good Lego piece for evaluation and reward modeling.

Name: CodeElo
What It Does: Benchmarking framework for competition-level code generation using Elo-style ratings.
Notes: Useful for measuring coding agent progress.

Name: Trinity-RFT
What It Does: Flexible reinforcement fine-tuning framework for large language models.
Notes: AgentScope ecosystem training layer.

Name: AgentJet
What It Does: Platform for LLM agent tuning with RL and benchmarking.
Notes: GitHub description emphasizes RL tuning and benchmarking.

Name: DashScope API
What It Does: Official Python SDK and API surface for hosted Qwen and related Alibaba AI models.
Notes: SpaceBot currently calls DashScope endpoints directly.

Name: ModelScope
What It Does: Core MaaS library for discovering running training and evaluating models across domains.
Notes: Also published on PyPI with active 2026 releases.

Name: modelscope-mcp-server
What It Does: Official ModelScope MCP server in active development.
Notes: Hidden-gem candidate because it directly exposes official MCP capability.

Name: Flash-LLM
What It Does: Sparse inference engine for efficient large generative model serving.
Lego Flags: Qwen models;Agent frameworks via hosted inference
Notes: Inference/deployment Lego piece rather than an end-user product.

Name: AdaSeq
What It Does: All-in-one library for sequence understanding and information extraction models.
Notes: NLP utility layer from ModelScope.

Name: DAMO-ConvAI
What It Does: Alibaba DAMO conversational AI codebase.
Notes: Important umbrella repo even though snippet did not expose current stars in our crawl.

Name: SpokenNLP
What It Does: Collection of research projects from Alibaba's SpokenNLP team.
Notes: Useful lower-visibility research bucket.

Name: RynnBrain
What It Does: Open embodied foundation model project from Alibaba DAMO Academy.
Notes: Core embodied stack anchor.

Name: RynnRCP
What It Does: Robotics context protocol for the Rynn ecosystem.
Notes: Hidden-gem infrastructure layer for embodied composition.

Name: RynnVLA-001
What It Does: Vision-language-action model project using human demonstrations to improve robot manipulation.
Notes: Early VLA line in the Rynn family.

Name: RynnVLA-002
What It Does: Unified vision-language-action and world model project.
Notes: Stronger next-step embodied platform piece.

Name: RynnMotion
What It Does: Framework for robot prototyping motion primitives teleoperation data collection and deployment.
Notes: Very low-star but highly composable robotics utility.

Name: DiffSynth-Studio
What It Does: Diffusion training and generation studio for image and video workflows.
Notes: One of the largest ModelScope visual-generation projects.

Name: Lumos
What It Does: Frontier video unified model research project from Alibaba DAMO Academy.
Notes: Official repo description explicitly frames it as video-model research.

Name: Lumos-Custom
What It Does: Research project for customized video generation within the Lumos family.
Notes: Specialized companion project to Lumos.

Name: Uni3C
What It Does: Framework for precise 3D-enhanced camera and human motion controls in video generation.
Notes: Strong Lego piece for controllable video generation.
